title: Lesson 2 — Literacy Foundations Knowledge Check
source: User-supplied WGU course review questions, November 21 2026

items.prompt: What is the first pillar of literacy according to the lesson?
items.feedback_correct: Phonemic awareness is the first pillar, focusing on understanding the sounds in words.

items.prompt: What does Scarborough's Reading Rope represent?

options.text: A ladder to success in reading
A big picture of how reading works

items.feedback_correct: Scarborough's Reading Rope is like a big picture of reading, showing how different skills are interconnected.

items.prompt: Which literacy approach emphasizes explicit instruction in the relationships between sounds and letters?
items.feedback_correct: Structured literacy is an evidence-based approach that emphasizes explicit instruction in phonics and other language structures.

items.prompt: What does phonemic awareness primarily focus on?
items.feedback_correct: Phonemic awareness involves manipulating individual sounds in words.
